governing_document: Odisha Development Authorities (Planning & Building Standards) Rules & Odisha ECBC Notification
authority: Housing & Urban Development Department, Govt of Odisha / ODA
climate_adaptations: Cyclonic wind protection measures in coastal districts (Puri, Ganjam, Jagatsinghpur, Kendrapara, Balasore, Bhadrak).
Heatwave action plan mandated cool roofs for public and low-income housing.
Mandatory minimum plinth height of 450mm above crown of adjacent road.

rules.description: Ground floor plinth must be at least 0.45 m (450 mm) above surrounding finished ground level to prevent waterlogging and seasonal inundation.
rules.remediation: Elevate ground slab or foundation grade beam to minimum 0.45m.

rules.description: Lightweight or pitched metal/tile roofs in coastal zones must incorporate J-bolt hurricane tie anchors at max 1.2m intervals connected into RCC tie beams.
rules.remediation: Verify positive mechanical hurricane tie anchorage between roof trusses and perimeter wall bond beams.

rules.clause: Odisha State Heat Action Plan - Building Code Adaptation
rules.description: Exposed non-vegetated roof slabs in urban and peri-urban areas must maintain high solar reflectance (SRI >= 78) to mitigate extreme summer surface heat.
rules.remediation: Apply high-albedo white reflective coating or install solar reflective tiles on top terrace surface.
